description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:1060 inside #[cfg(test)] mod tests — `extern crate std;` triggers clippy's unused-extern-crates lint with -D warnings. cargo clippy -p pkix-path-builder --all-features --tests -- -D warnings fails the workspace pre-push check (AGENTS.md). The crate's #![cfg_attr(not(feature = "std"), no_std)] means under default-feature builds std is already accessible; the extern crate declaration is redundant. Fix: delete the line, or replace with use std::{...}; in the test bodies (current tests already write std::format!, std::fs::read, etc. with absolute paths so the extern is genuinely unused).
title: cargo clippy --tests fails: unused extern crate std
